headline: Laptops built on Nvidia's new Arm-based RTX Spark chip are on pre-order from $2,600 up to $7,000, with deliveries due from about 16 Oct.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: first prices and ship date for a new Windows laptop platform from Nvidia, though only for premium buyers.
importance_line: Windows laptops now have a high-end Arm platform of the kind Qualcomm's Snapdragon models offer, but the prices put them out of reach of most buyers, and the graphics match to an RTX 5070 is so far only on paper.
summary: PCWorld reports that Microsoft, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo have opened pre-orders for the first laptops using RTX Spark, Nvidia's Arm-based chip for Windows PCs, from $2,600 for Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra (up to $5,900 fully loaded) to $7,000 for a larger Asus model. Nvidia unveiled the chip earlier this week; the new facts are the prices and a shipping date of about 16 Oct, with some models, such as Dell's, still missing specifications.
notes: Follow-up of 1005:C08-03 (Nvidia PC processor unveiling, pool only) and of the 6 Oct edition item on AMD's Gorgon Halo tests; pre-order and price details are new today. Full text read at PCWorld.
